Monument_Completed: HEARTS CAN NOW BE COLLECTED INSTANTLY!
Monument3_Completed: SPIRIT INCREASED BY ONE HUNDRED! CONGRATS!
Monument4_Completed: UTOPIUM HARVEST LIMIT DOUBLED IN THAW SEASON! CONGRATS!
MonumentPart1_Desc: We've stumbled upon something particularly fascinating, old chap. It looks like we're going to have to sink in a lot of time and money to figure out what it is!
MonumentPart2_Desc: Though we've got our best clones on the job, we can't quite tell what's going on in here. Progress is slow, but steady.
MonumentPart3_Desc: The design is puzzling. It's unlike anything we've seen before. An ancient facade seems to be taking shape.
MonumentPart4_Desc: This is turning out to be quite the adventure. They should turn this expedition into a movie some day. Or maybe even a game.
MonumentPart5_Desc: We're going to need more money, old chap. We may just have chanced upon something incredible. Something invaluable. Something that might change... everything.
MonumentPart6_Desc: Something has been kept secret in the hollows of this structure, for a long, long time.
MonumentPart7_Desc: What if this is just a wild goose chase? What if it's all a distraction from the bigger questions? As the team grows, it team grows restless.
MonumentPart8_Desc: This is it. We're almost there. We must not lose focus. We must not lose hope. And above all else, we must not lose love.
MonumentPart9_Desc: A new rediscovery has been made! It appears that hearts never need to be pumped at all. Try it out yourself, old chap. I'm not sure what to make of it myself.
Monument3Part1_Desc: A new riddle from ancient times. I tell you old chap, it's like there's an entire planet's worth of artefacts floating about in the space around us.
Monument3Part2_Desc: This mystery is barely skin deep! It seems like we're already at the bottom of it. Or are we? Could this be the fabled underwater base from Earth?
Monument3Part3_Desc: Look at this charming fellow in the Mech Bay. He looks like some kind of medical assistant. What operations were they performing here?
Monument3Part4_Desc: A short puzzle, but fulfilling nonetheless. This face will lift our spirits to new heights. Go on, bask in the glory and enjoy the extra spirit!
Monument4Part1_Desc: I believe it was Mothership's will that we should come back, so that men might know the things that are in the world... - Mako Polo
Monument4Part2_Desc: Some mayors give up their designs when they have almost reached the goal; While others, on the contrary, obtain a Utopia by exerting, at the last moment, more vigorous efforts than ever before. - Herobotus
Monument4Part3_Desc: I propose to construct a new chart for navigating, on which I shall delineate all the sea and lands of the cosmos in their proper positions...  to put down all as it were in a picture... - Chrystofer Cumulus
Monument4Part4_Desc: No borders, just horizons - only endless space.. - Emilia Earheart
Monument2Part1_Desc: My goodness, Old Chap! We've struck something again. I reckon it's going to be another long road ahead, but I have a feeling it will be worth it.
Monument2Part2_Desc: Are you sure that this will pay off? It seems like quite a gamble. At this point we can't even tell for sure what we're staring at.
Monument2Part3_Desc: This style of construction is most peculiar. We can't quite tell head or tail of it as yet. But we soldier on, growing older and stronger.
Monument2Part4_Desc: Aha! The structure finally begins to take shape. Or so we think. Is this a modern colisseum of sorts? Did gladiators battle within the confines of these walls?
Monument2Part5_Desc: What's this? The monument seems to have been built to protect and contain some kind of... turf. Was this a museum for the precious material known as grass?
Monument2Part6_Desc: More infrastructure for spectators. What could be so fascinating about watching grass grow?
Monument2Part7_Desc: Our secondary unit is investigating the subterranean levels of the monument in hopes of finding more clues to this mysterious edifice.
Monument2Part8_Desc: The fabled earth cup! This was the venue for the greatest athletic warriors of our world. It looks like it's time again for a celebration of sport!
Monument2Part9_Desc: What can I say. We were expecting another miracle at the end of this excavation. But it looks like we'll just have to settle for a magnificent playground instead.

Hotel_NewsFeed: Hotel to consider actually offering rooms to Utopians, after incessant demands from residents wanting to renovate their homes.
MissionControl_NewsFeed: Most Utopians feel ambivalent about the presence of new members from Utopia HQ in town. Rise in animal disappearances however may be a long-term cause for concern. Utopia Corp. ensures that there is nothing to worry about.
MissionControl_BuildPreview: Because we're on a mission here.
Hotel_MoreDesc: When Utopians need a swish staycay, Hotel Utopia is their top choice. A VACATION removes clones from their residence and workplace. To check them out, have a vacant residence space for them.
MissionControl_MoreDesc: Utopia Corp's mission control was set up to closely monitor the stranger discoveries being made in towns. Samples are periodically collected and beamed up, to fuel cutting edge research at the Mothership. Architects designed the building to consist of 4 towers, each representing one core value of the Corporation. NOTE: Mayors are warned that all animals, utopium, and coins committed to missions will be permanently taken away in exchange for rewards. Some rewards can be bought out using Utopium.

Tutorial_Desc_1: GOOD MORNING MAYOR. YOU MADE IT TO UTOPIA! WE HOPE YOU ENJOY REBUILDING THIS PIECE OF HUMANITY
Tutorial_Desc_2: FIRST YOU MUST BUILD RESIDENCES FOR YOUR CLONES TO STAY IN. TAP ON THE FLASHING SQUARE TO GET STARTED.
Tutorial_Desc_3: GREAT! A BRAND NEW RESIDENCE IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION. TAP ON THE BUILDING SITE TO SEE THE PROGRESS MADE.
Tutorial_Desc_4: CONSTRUCTION REQUIRES TIME, BUT EVERYTHING MOVES FASTER WITH 'UTOPIUM'. TRY TO 'RUSH' THE BUILDING.
Tutorial_Desc_5: EXCELLENT. THE NEW HOMES ARE READY!
Tutorial_Desc_6: NOW THAT THEIR HOMES ARE BUILT, NEW 'CLONES' WILL ARRIVE SHORTLY. TAP ON THE 'ARRIVAL CENTER' TO WELCOME THEM.
Tutorial_Desc_7: WELCOME TO THE ARRIVAL CENTER! AS THE RESIDENT MECHANIC, THIS IS WHERE I WORK ON NEW 'CLONES'.
Tutorial_Desc_8: SOME 'CLONES' ARE ALREADY ON THEIR WAY NOW. LET'S 'RUSH' THEIR ARRIVAL.
Tutorial_Desc_9: CONGRATULATIONS! YOUR FIRST 'CLONE' HAS ARRIVED! TAP ON THEIR PORTRAIT SO WE CAN FIND SOMETHING FOR THEM TO DO.
Tutorial_Desc_10: THESE NEW CLONES ARE BLANK SLATES. WE'LL GENETICALLY PROVIDE THEM WITH A NEW IDENTITY. TAP ON 'SPLICE ME'!
Tutorial_Desc_11: THIS IS THE GENE BANK. WE CURRENTLY HAVE SAMPLES ONLY FOR 'MECHANIC' AND 'MAYOR'. MIX THESE TO SEE WHAT YOU GET!
Tutorial_Desc_12: FIRST, TAP ON THE 'ADMINISTRATION' CATEGORY ON THE LEFT, AND THEN SELECT THE 'MAYOR' GENE
Tutorial_Desc_13: GREAT. NOW TAP ON THE 'TECHNICAL' CATEGORY ON THE RIGHT, AND THEN SELECT THE 'MECHANIC' GENE
Tutorial_Desc_14: YOU FOUND A MATCH! TAP ON THE PINK LIQUID IN THE MIDDLE TO BEGIN THE SPLICING PROCESS.
Tutorial_Desc_15: GENE SPLICING IS NOW IN PROGRESS.\nLET'S WAIT AND SEE WHAT THE RESULT IS!
Tutorial_Desc_16: EUREKA! AN 'ENGINEER' WAS CREATED! AS A REWARD, WE WILL OFTEN SEND YOU NEW BUILDINGS WHEN YOU FIND A NEW JOB.
Tutorial_Desc_17: A NEW BUILDING IS NOW ON IT'S WAY. TAP ON THE FLASHING SQUARE FOR US TO BEAM IT DOWN:
Tutorial_Desc_18: NOW 'RUSH' THE CONSTRUCTION OF THIS NEW BUILDING TO SEE WHAT IT IS!
Tutorial_Desc_19: YOUR 'UTOPIUM MINE' IS READY! GO BACK TO THE 'ARRIVAL CENTER' AND PUT OUR EAGER 'ENGINEER' TO WORK!
Tutorial_Desc_20: THE 'ENGINEER' IS READY TO GO! TAP ON THEIR PORTRAIT.
Tutorial_Desc_21: TAP THE 'UTOPIUM MINE' BUTTON TO SEND THE 'ENGINEER' TO WORK THERE!
Tutorial_Desc_22: LASTLY, YOU NEED TO ACTIVATE THE BUILDING TO START PRODUCING COINS.
Tutorial_Desc_23: TAP ON THE 'MINE' TO START WORK THERE.
Tutorial_Desc_24: THAT'S IT! YOUR TRAINING IS COMPLETE! GO FORTH, EXPLORE, AND RECREATE AS MUCH AS YOU CAN ON THIS BOLD JOURNEY.
Tutorial_Desc_25: QUICK RECAP: BUILD RESIDENCES TO GET MORE CLONES. GO TO THE ARRIVAL CENTER TO SPLICE NEW CLONES.
Tutorial_Desc_26: THERE ARE %i UNIQUE JOBS TO DISCOVER! OUR FUTURE DEPENDS ON IT. NO PRESSURE. BYE!

MiniQuest_Altar_Desc0: Now you can splice animals! Enter the ALTAR, browse and see what animals you have. Choose any two to see if a splice is possible and try one!\nThe Mothership has a gift to kick start this project!
MiniQuest_Altar_Desc1: Go on, splice an animal, any one. As you splice more animals, you'll get better at it!\n\nRemember: SPLICING ANIMALS is a way to get animals you don't have.
MiniQuest_Altar_Desc2: Certain animals cannot be obtained through usual means, and the only way to get them is to splice them.\n\nA reward for splicing a unique, Tier 3, animal awaits!
MiniQuest_Altar_Desc3: Legends tell of majestic, mystical creatures to be discovered via the altar. They can't be obtained through packs or collected, and must be spliced.\nA reward for discovering a Tier 5 animal awaits!
MiniQuest_Park_Desc0: Now you can build Decors, increasing Utopia's SPIRIT. Spirit reduces the cost of expansion and wait times. Tap any Decor, or the Arrival Center to see Discount.\n\nBuild Decor using the LANDSCAPE menu!
MiniQuest_Park_Desc1: As you town expands, so does the Spirit levels required to maintain or increase discount. Build more Decors to raise Spirits!\nRaise enough Spirit to reach 20% discount to expansion costs and waiting times.
MiniQuest_Park_Desc2: You've made great progress in raising Utopia's Spirit levels, and every Utopian is beginning to feel more pep in their step. Keep it up!\nRaise enough Spirit to reach 30% discount to expansion costs and waiting times.
MiniQuest_Park_Desc3: Check out the TV Station after you've unlocked it. You can obtain unique Decors there to help you raise Spirits!\nRaise enough Spirit to reach 40% discount to expansion costs and waiting times.
MiniQuest_MissionControl_Desc0: You can now launch missions to earn special rewards! Enter UTOPIA HQ and learn what jobs, animals, or resources are needed.\n\nTry launching a mission successfully.
MiniQuest_MissionControl_Desc1: The Mothership heartily congratulates you on the success of your first launch. Utopians all over witnessed in awe as the inaugural mission pod blasted off. \n\nNOTE: Some missions unlock special genes when completed!
MiniQuest_MissionControl_Desc2: The Mothership heartily congratulates you on the success of your first launch. Utopians all over witnessed in awe as the inaugural mission pod blasted off. \n\nNOTE: Some missions unlock special genes when completed!
MiniQuest_MissionControl_Desc3: With so many launches, Utopia is now firmly in the Space(ier) Age! Keep up in the race into the great beyond!\n\nNOTE: Special genes unlock based on the season and number of jobs discovered.
MiniQuest_Bank_Desc0: Do you know that the Bank helps to DOUBLE Coins earned Per Second (CPS) in any building that have ALL its jobs filled up? Fill up as many buildings as you can to earn more coins, faster! Meet the condition below for your next reward!
MiniQuest_Bank_Desc1: Fill up as many buildings as you can to earn more coins, faster! The Bank doubles CPS earned in a full building. You can spend Utopium to reveal job recipes in empty slots. Meet the condition below for your next reward!
MiniQuest_Bank_Desc2: You've gotten Utopia's financial engine purring! No sense in stopping now so keep filling up those job slots and upgrading your buildings! Don't worry. This bank can't burst. Meet the condition below for your next reward!
MiniQuest_TV Station_Desc0: Your TV station doesn't just broadcast awesome shows. Its Shopping Channel allows you to buy unique decors, trees, and houses! What's more, these DON'T add to your land count!\nGo CALL-IN now!
MiniQuest_TV Station_Desc1: Make more purchases! The list of items on sale are refreshed with new ones regularly. Don't worry about missing out though as you always get another chance to purchase something you missed.
MiniQuest_TV Station_Desc2: Looks like you've managed to take advantage of the great offers on the Shopping Channel! If you would like to change the items on sale in the catalogue, simply click on 'Refresh Now'.
MiniQuest_Calendar_Desc0: Have you checked out the calendar? Look for the icon at the bottom left of your screen: each day, a daily gift will be available. These include Chroma, Utopium, and even animals!
MiniQuest_Calendar_Desc1: Do you know that some animals appear only in certain seasons? The calendar shows what season Utopia is in!\n\nSeasons change every week!
MiniQuest_Calendar_Desc2: Do you know that some animals appear only in certain seasons? The calendar shows what season Utopia is in!\n\nSeasons change every week!
MiniQuest_Calendar_Desc3: Do you know that some animals appear only in certain seasons? The calendar shows what season Utopia is in!\n\nSeasons change every week!
MiniQuest_Town Hall_Desc0: You can manually save the progress of your Utopia by visiting the Town Hall's setting menu. Use 'Manage Save File' to make backup copies of Utopia in case of calamities!\n\nSave now to collect a gift.
MiniQuest_Town Hall_Bottom0: VISIT TOWN HALL AND SAVE THE GAME
